svg.text: Travel move d = 26 m, v = 3 m/s, a = 0.5 m/s² · black = trapezoid (twin), blue = S-curve with jerk j = 0.6 m/s³
jerk (m/s³) – trapezoid: infinite at the corners
full speed if d ≥ v²/a = 18 m
ramp time of the acceleration t_j = a/j
good: no jump in acceleration = less mast sway,
less shock on the load and the rail
choose t_j = 1 / f_mast (1.2 Hz: t_j = 0.83 s, j = a·f = 0.6)
slower axis may use a lower speed and arrive
at the same time: d = v'·(T − v'/a)
example: hoist 5 m in T = 14.67 s → v' = 0.358 m/s
(less peak power, smoother, same cycle time)
EXAMPLE – check the AS/RS supplier's documentation
